newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Green Cross to list new preferred shrs.
newsitem.headline: Green Cross to list new preferred shrs.

text.p: Green Cross Corp will list 4,862 new preferred shares with higher dividends on the Korean Stock Exchange on March 19, a company official said on Tuesday.
The official at the nation's leading pharmaceutical company said the preferred shares would guarantee at least nine percent cash dividends.
The dividend payment will not be allowed to exceed 15 percent.
At present, all Korean preferred shares pay dividends one percent higher than common shares but hold no voting rights.
"If we decide to give dividend payments higher than nine percent for common stocks, that will also apply to the new preferred stocks," the official said.
In calendar 1996, Green Cross decided on three percent stock dividends and eight percent in cash for common shares.
